speaker: M. L. Kontsevich
title: Formal uniformization of curves and the Virasoro action
summary: The mathematical contribution headed Kontsevich occupies P001258: a curve with a marked point and formal coordinate is acted on by Laurent vector fields, and the Virasoro extension lifts the action to determinant lines. P001257 is a continuation of Beilinson, not part of this contribution. The catalogue date is retained, although the heading visibly reads \(24/\mathrm{II}\text{-}85\); neighboring headings consistently read 1986. Consequently the record cannot establish priority relative to the paper received in December 1986.

speaker: A. Yu. Morozov
title: Bosonic string measure, determinants, and the conformal anomaly
summary: The actual talk begins on P001259 and ends on P001261 before Beilinson. It reduces the critical bosonic-string functional integral formally to a moduli integral and explains the determinants, zero modes, and holomorphic factorization underlying that reduction. Gelfand asks about multiplicativity of regularized determinants. The heading reads \(24.2.86\); the catalogue date is preserved with this disagreement recorded.

speaker: A. A. Beilinson
title: Mixed Hodge structures, real splitting, and Green-function periods
summary: The contribution starts on P001262 and ends at the beginning of P001265. It presents mixed Hodge structures in filtration and split forms, then interprets an extension attached to a punctured curve with two relative marked points through Green functions. The heading reads \(3/\mathrm{III}\text{-}86\), a year earlier than the retained catalogue date.

speaker: A. Yu. Morozov
title: String amplitudes, Green functions, and the superstring measure
summary: The continuation headed Morozov starts midway through P001265 and runs through P001267. It connects the string description to gauge fields, discusses explicit bosonic measures and theta functions, and asks how to obtain the superstring measure by eliminating odd variables. The catalogue range includes neighboring contributions; the items below use the actual headings. The manuscript belongs to the \(3/\mathrm{III}\text{-}86\) session.

speaker: A. Yu. Morozov
title: Compactification, lattice theta series, and heterotic gauge symmetry
summary: The contribution begins on P001268 and continues through P001273. It combines gauge fields, the string oscillator spectrum, compactification on a sixteen-dimensional torus, modular lattice sums, and root vertex operators. Several formulas mix ordinary bosonic compactification with the chiral heterotic construction. The manuscript date is \(10/\mathrm{III}\text{-}86\), whereas the catalogue says 1987.

speaker: D. B. Fuchs
title: Topology of real subspace arrangements and complexifiability
summary: The contribution starts on P001274 and ends on P001276. Fuchs explains the Goresky--MacPherson arrangement theorem through order complexes and stratified Morse theory, including a small example and the special case of \(k\)-arrangements. Gelfand asks about realization, common complex structures, and useful cohomology bases. The manuscript date is \(24.\mathrm{III}.86\), not the catalogue year 1987.

speaker: A. N. Varchenko
title: Asymptotic mixed Hodge structures and singularity spectra
summary: The actual contribution is P001277--P001280. It relates mixed Hodge structures to powers and logarithms in singular integrals, develops the Milnor-fibre setting, and describes the asymptotic filtration and semicontinuity of spectra. Gelfand asks for several functions and for pairs of quadrics. These are separated from the established one-function isolated-singularity theorem.

speaker: I. V. Cherednik
title: RTT algebras, finite-level Yangians, and PBW questions
summary: Cherednik starts on P001281 and finishes near the top of P001282. The rational RTT equation defines a homogeneous version of a truncated Yangian, with a finite-level PBW claim and a level-one enveloping-algebra example. Gelfand asks for a broader quadratic-algebra criterion. Kogan begins later on P001282. The manuscript heading reads \(7/\mathrm{IV}\text{-}86\).

speaker: Yan I. Kogan
title: Covariant bosonic string states, constraints, and string fields
summary: The talk begins midway through P001282 and continues through P001286. It derives the oscillator and Virasoro description, explains the mass tower and physical-state constraints, and moves toward gauge symmetry and interacting string fields. Several sign, mode-index, and level labels are faithfully wrong in the notebook and are emended explicitly. The shared heading reads April 1986.

speaker: I. V. Cherednik
title: Quantum determinants, centers, and fusion
summary: The actual talk occupies P001287--P001289. It repeats the finite-level RTT construction, defines its determinant by antisymmetrization, states the polynomial-center theorem, and uses tensor products and Young diagrams to build representations. Matrix size \(N\) and level \(n\) are repeatedly interchanged in the notebook. The date visibly reads 28 April 1986.

speaker: G. I. Olshanskii
title: A strong-limit enveloping algebra and its Yangian factor
summary: The talk occupies P001290 and the beginning of P001291. It defines an enlargement of the enveloping algebra through bounded-degree, tail-invariant sequences acting on tensor representations, then identifies its central factor and Yangian factor. The exact 1987 Doklady note was presented by Gelfand on 5 May 1986, matching the manuscript heading and independently corroborating the date discrepancy.

speaker: I. V. Cherednik
title: Highest weights and quantum characteristic polynomials
summary: The continuation starts midway through P001291 and runs to the end of P001292. It evaluates the quantum determinant in a highest-weight representation and compares it with ordinary determinants, including a two-dimensional antisymmetrizer calculation. The later year heading and September material on the catalogue range are separate records.

This catalogue record is a year heading, not a separate mathematical talk. The preceding page ends the May quantum-determinant discussion, while P001293 begins the explicitly dated 1 September 1986 session. The overlapping catalogue range does not transfer either contribution to this heading.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Matroids, Coxeter groups, and quadratic duality
summary: The actual contribution begins on P001293. Gelfand discusses work with Serganova on matroids and torus strata, explains the Coxeter-group extension, and then presents quadratic algebras in connection with Beilinson and Ginzburg. The agenda also names Cherednik, but it contains no separate Gelfand--Tsetlin result on these pages. Several elementary examples retain useful manuscript errors: intersection-preserving closure, two-generator finiteness, and the distinction between the two groups of order 120.

speaker: V. L. Ginzburg
title: Complete symmetric varieties and polynomial quotients of affine Hecke algebras
summary: Ginzburg presents the De Concini--Procesi compactification of symmetric varieties, then a finite and affine Hecke-algebra construction. The top of P001298 records a problem attributed explicitly to Cherednik: replace the evaluation of the last lattice generator by a polynomial relation. Ovsienko and Kazakov start separate contributions lower on that page and are indexed with their own records. The catalogue initial is preserved although the mathematical attribution to the speaker known as Victor Ginzburg is conventional.
